rows.label: Response Timeline for Individual Rights Requests

pipl.value: Article 46: within 15 working days after verification

gdpr.value: Article 20: consent or contract basis only. Machine-readable format.

ccpa.value: Right to Know includes specific pieces. Portability not explicitly required.

lgpd.value: Article 18, V: subject to ANPD regulation. Still developing.

pipl.value: Article 45: access plus transfer channel where CAC conditions met.

gdpr.value: Article 22: right not to be subject to solely automated decisions with legal effects. Exceptions apply with human review safeguard.

ccpa.value: No direct equivalent right. Profiling restrictions apply in some contexts.

lgpd.value: Article 20: right to review of automated decisions. Similar to GDPR.

pipl.value: Article 24: opt-out, human review, non-personalized options, and anti-differential pricing provision.

ccpa.value: Without unreasonable delay. No fixed hour threshold.

pipl.value: Immediately upon discovery. Some sectors specify 24 hours.

gdpr.value: Article 34: without undue delay where high risk to individuals

ccpa.value: Required for breaches of defined sensitive data categories

lgpd.value: Article 48: when relevant harm may occur to data subjects

pipl.value: Article 57: immediately. May be replaced by public announcement if harm avoided.

gdpr.value: Not required. Cross-border transfers permitted under Chapter V mechanisms.

lgpd.value: Not required. Cross-border transfers permitted under ANPD-approved mechanisms.

pipl.value: Required for CIIOs and handlers processing above CAC volume thresholds. CAC security assessment required for transfers.

ccpa.value: No specific cross-border transfer restrictions. Service provider contracts required.

lgpd.value: Adequacy recognition, ANPD-approved SCCs, BCRs, specific consent (Articles 33-36)

pipl.value: CAC security assessment, certification, CAC standard contracts only. No adequacy decision mechanism. GDPR SCCs not recognized.

gdpr.value: Opt-in. Affirmative consent required before processing where consent is the legal basis.

ccpa.value: Opt-out model for most processing. Opt-in required for sale/sharing of minors' data.

lgpd.value: Opt-in. Consent must be free, informed, unambiguous, and purpose-specific. Closely aligned with GDPR.

pipl.value: Opt-in. Separate consent required per purpose. Bundled consent not permitted.

gdpr.value: Any organization processing EU resident data regardless of size, location, or profit status.

ccpa.value: For-profit businesses only, meeting one of three revenue/data volume thresholds.

lgpd.value: Any person or entity, public or private, processing data of individuals in Brazil.

pipl.value: Any handler processing personal information of individuals within China, including extraterritorially.

gdpr.value: Mandatory DPO for public authorities, large-scale monitoring, and special category processing.

ccpa.value: No mandatory privacy officer role. Privacy program obligations exist without a named officer requirement.

lgpd.value: Encarregado mandatory for controllers. Broader requirement than GDPR DPO threshold.

pipl.value: Handlers processing above a threshold must designate a person responsible for PIPL compliance.

gdpr.value: Article 9: racial/ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs, trade union membership, genetic data, biometric data, health data, sex life/sexual orientation.

ccpa.value: Broader list including SSNs, financial credentials, precise geolocation, racial/ethnic origin, religious beliefs, union membership, communications contents, genetic data, biometric data, health, sex life.

lgpd.value: Racial/ethnic origin, religious belief, political opinion, union/religious membership, health/sex data, genetic/biometric data. Similar to GDPR.

pipl.value: Biometric characteristics, religious beliefs, specially designated status, medical health, financial accounts, personal location tracking, personal information of minors under 14.

rows.label: Right to Opt Out of Sale or Sharing

gdpr.value: No direct equivalent. Article 21 Right to Object covers adjacent ground for legitimate interest processing.

ccpa.value: Explicit right to opt out of sale and sharing (including cross-context behavioral advertising). GPC signal must be honored.

lgpd.value: No direct equivalent right. Consent withdrawal and deletion rights address some similar scenarios.

pipl.value: No direct equivalent right. Individual consent framework addresses some similar scenarios.

gdpr.value: Article 35: mandatory PIA for high-risk processing. Supervisory authorities publish trigger lists.

ccpa.value: CPPA has authority to require risk assessments under CPRA. Regulations still developing.

lgpd.value: Article 38: ANPD may require reports for risky processing. Trigger criteria still developing.

pipl.value: Article 55: mandatory PIPIA before processing sensitive data, automated decisions, third-party sharing, international transfers, and other high-impact activities. Broader trigger scope than GDPR.
